shots.beat: Subject A asks what standard defines a genuinely accomplished person.

prompt.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in an orange shirt sits in the entrance-side aisle seat and asks what standard defines an accomplished person, while a man in a white shirt sits in the pinboard-side aisle seat, a woman in a blue shirt sits in the pinboard-side window seat, and a woman in a yellow shirt sits in the entrance-side window seat.
prompt.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the entrance end, looking along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the pinboard in frame.

shots.beat: Subject A and Subject B exchange their established seats. Subject B replies that true accomplishment demands extensive creative study and technical mastery.

prompt.content: The woman in an orange shirt and the man in a white shirt exchange seats, and he replies that true accomplishment demands creative study and technical mastery.
prompt.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side seats.

shots.beat: Subject A asks whether anyone can satisfy such demanding expectations.
